content.short: SNARK is a zero-knowledge tooling platform.
content.description: zk-SNARK stands for Zero-Knowledge Succinct Non-interactive Argument of Knowledge. It is a zero-knowledge proof system that lets a party prove knowledge of a secret to another party without revealing the secret itself. A defining feature is its non-interactive nature, which provides confidentiality without any back-and-forth communication between the prover and the verifier. This succinct, non-interactive approach sets zk-SNARK apart from many other zero-knowledge schemes by prioritizing privacy while maintaining verifiable correctness.
